page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; left margin holds marginal notes (one at the top beside "Luc.9.31", and three in the lower left: "b Homil.57. in Matthæu. c Homil.55."). Running head at top; page number at top left. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: sibi Ierosolymam abeundum esse, ibique moriendum: id jam, quum Luc.9.31. idem dicitur à Moise & Elia, perturbatus fuadet; Domine, quosum ista de obitu tuo in Ierusalem? Bonum est nos hic esse: si vis, faciamus hic tria tabernacula, in quibus tecum manent Moses & Elias; & in hoc splendore, claritate, gloria, perpetuò degamus. Verum ut oratio Petri satis indicat, non adeò consternatum & attonitum fuisse, quia sciret quid sibi vellet; tametsi parum reputans quid vel le potius deberet: ita Bellarminus, dicens raptum esse quodammodo extra se, non simpliciter raptum extra se, & animi impotem, sed quodammodo, satis labefactat assertionem suam, Petrum nullo modo in tali mentis excessu peccare potuisse. Immo, & peccasse, docet laudando Chrysostomum in hunc locum. Quippe cujus verba, Petrum amore maximo, sed haud quaquam prudenter hortatum esse, respiciunt quod praemiserat, eum, qui aperte & audacter antea hortatus erat Christum ne morti se offerret, id jam occultius agere: nec enim moriturum, nisi adiret Ierosolymam, locum illius morti destinatum; & eam non aditurum, si maneret in monte, tabernaculis ad perpetuae habitationis commoditatem excitatis. Ita, quum idem à Petro factum esse b Homil.57. in Matthæu. hoc loco doceat Chrysostomus, quod superiore factum docuerat; & in eo Petrum lapsum, immo graviter lapsum esse, dicat: restat sententiam Magdeburgensium judicio Chrysostomi in genere probari; videlicet Petrum peccasse. Peccati quidem speciem videntur Magdeburgenses non satis animadvertisse, qui eum in memoriam rei istius tabernacula fieri voluisse autumant.

page.notes: Marginal note "c Homil.55." sits beside the line "eo Petrum" in the left margin, placed with the preceding note; "b Homil.57. in Matthæu." is set beside "factum esse". Heavy show-through and staining along the left edge; the line "Luc.9.31." is printed as "Luc.9.31." in the margin. Some words near the right edge are faint: "quia sciret" and "tametsi" read with [?] where uncertain. Original text reads "fatis" and "Bellarminus" as printed; the sentence "Magdeburgensium judicio" and "satis animadvertisse" are clear. Three marginal references in the lower left should be treated as one block of notes with letters b and c.
